zcashPending.body: Login with Zcash signs a challenge with your wallet key, so it stays in ZUULI until the cross-surface bridge ships. Use a password or a linked account here.
zcashPending.title: Zcash login is not on this surface yet

blocked.body: free2z prepared a request for {amount} to {creator} and holds no key to sign it. The verified link to ZUULI is not live yet, so nothing was sent.
blocked.title: ZEC tips are signed in ZUULI

declined.body: The payment was not approved in ZUULI, so nothing was sent to {creator}. Your ZEC is untouched.
declined.title: ZUULI did not authorize this tip

indeterminate.body: free2z cannot tell what happened to this {amount} tip for {creator}. Open ZUULI and check for a pending transaction before sending again.
indeterminate.title: free2z did not get an answer

unsent.body: This creator's payment details cannot be carried across the bridge, so ZUULI was never asked and nothing was sent.
unsent.title: free2z could not send this request

notFound.description: This page doesn't exist or has moved. Let's get you back on track.
notFound.title: Page not found

fund.body: Buying 2Zs still lives in ZUULI while its Zcash top-up path is separated from the card checkout. It moves to free2z next.
fund.title: Add 2Zs

failure.endedRoom: This stream has ended or is no longer accepting viewers.
failure.expiredTicket: The join ticket expired before the connection started. Try again.
failure.lifecycleRace: The stream changed while you were joining. Return to livestreams and open it again.
failure.malformedTicket: The stream server returned an invalid join ticket. Try again in a moment.
failure.offline: You're offline. Reconnect, then try again.
failure.policy: The app blocked the live connection. Check app permissions or network security settings, then try again.
failure.replayedTicket: The stream server did not issue a fresh join ticket. Try again in a moment.
failure.timeout: The live connection timed out. Try again.
failure.tokenRejected: The live service rejected this connection. Try again.
failure.transport: The live service couldn't be reached. Switch networks or try again.
failure.unknown: The live connection failed. Try again.

stage.hostRecoveryHint: Reconnect uses the existing room and will not start another stream.
